title: Water before the Match
story: Before the match, Coach Elena told the team to drink water. Omar had forgotten his bottle, so a teammate shared hers. They stretched and jogged around the court twice. During the game Omar felt hot but kept going. At the break he sat in the shade and ate a banana. The team won by two points. Omar filled his bottle for next time.
